name: RVB (ООО «РВБ», combined Wildberries–Russ company)
note: Per Tinkoff Journal (July 2026): 65% held by ООО «Вайлдберриз», wholly owned by Tatyana Kim; 35% by ООО «Стинн» (half Grigory Sadoyan, half the undisclosed ZPIF «Гало»). Stinn was being merged into RVB from April 2026, final structure unknown.
